items.name: CompletionItem
items.summary: Represents a completion value and metadata about the value. The default metadata is ``type`` to indicate special shell handling, and ``help`` if a shell supports showing a help string next to the value.

members.name: complete
members.summary: Produce the completion data to send back to the shell.

members.name: format_completion
members.summary: Format a completion item into the form recognized by the shell script. This must be implemented by subclasses.

members.name: func_name
members.summary: The name of the shell function defined by the completion script.

members.name: get_completion_args
members.summary: Use the env vars defined by the shell script to return a tuple of ``args, incomplete``. This must be implemented by subclasses.

members.name: get_completions
members.signature: def get_completions(self, args: list[str], incomplete: str) -> list[CompletionItem]
members.summary: Determine the context and last complete command or parameter from the complete args. Call that object's ``shell_complete`` method to get the completions for the incomplete value.

members.name: name
members.summary: Name to register the shell as with `add_completion_class`. This is used in completion instructions (``{name}_source`` and ``{name}_complete``).

members.name: source
members.summary: Produce the shell script that defines the completion function. By default this ``%``-style formats `source_template` with the dict returned by `source_vars`.

members.name: source_template
members.summary: Completion script template formatted by `source`. This must be provided by subclasses.

items.name: ShellComplete
items.summary: Base class for providing shell completion support. A subclass for a given shell will override attributes and methods to implement the completion instructions (``source`` and ``complete``).

items.name: _is_incomplete_argument
items.summary: Determine if the given parameter is an argument that can still accept values.

items.name: _is_incomplete_option
items.signature: def _is_incomplete_option(ctx: Context, args: list[str], param: Parameter) -> bool
items.summary: Determine if the given parameter is an option that needs a value.

items.name: _resolve_context
items.signature: def _resolve_context(cli: Command, ctx_args: MutableMapping[str, Any], prog_name: str, args: list[str]) -> Context
items.summary: Produce the context hierarchy starting with the command and traversing the complete arguments. This only follows the commands, it doesn't trigger input prompts or callbacks.

items.name: _resolve_incomplete
items.signature: def _resolve_incomplete(ctx: Context, args: list[str], incomplete: str) -> tuple[Command | Parameter, str]
items.summary: Find the Click object that will handle the completion of the incomplete value. Return the object and the incomplete value.

items.name: _start_of_option
items.summary: Check if the value looks like the start of an option.

items.name: add_completion_class
items.signature: def add_completion_class(cls: ShellCompleteType, name: str) -> ShellCompleteType
items.summary: Register a `ShellComplete` subclass under the given name. The name will be provided by the completion instruction environment variable during completion.

items.name: get_completion_class
items.summary: Look up a registered `ShellComplete` subclass by the name provided by the completion instruction environment variable. If the name isn't registered, returns ``None``.

items.name: split_arg_string
items.summary: Split an argument string as with `shlex.split`, but don't fail if the string is incomplete. Ignores a missing closing quote or incomplete escape sequence and uses the partial token as-is.
